Open the Hugging Face repository meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Report the license name, current likes count, and whether the repository is gated. Use the repository’s visible metadata rather than guessing from the model name.

Stopping condition: Stop after the license, likes, and gated-status evidence have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not request access or download model files.
